Noto Sans KR 2.004 (Noto Sans CJK, Korean subset OTF), Regular and Bold

Licence:  SIL Open Font License 1.1 (LICENSE). Bundling with the app is allowed; the licence file
          must go with the fonts (the build and the installer copy the whole folder)
Added:    2026-11-20

Used by:  PDF export (MissionLedgerCore/src/module/export/MLPDFDocument.cpp looks for
          fonts/NotoSansKR-Regular.otf and NotoSansKR-Bold.otf next to the executable,
          or in Contents/Resources/fonts/ of the macOS app bundle)
Why:      the same font on Windows and macOS (Malgun Gothic does not exist on macOS, and the
          macOS system font has no separate bold face for export). docs/CI_PLAN.md §0 "PDF font"

Coverage: checked 2026-11-20 with sample characters in an exported PDF: Hangul, Korean Hanja
          (大韓民國 學校), kana, Japanese shinjitai (気 駅 広) and Traditional Chinese (們這說話) are
          drawn; Simplified Chinese (们这说话) is not (boxes). Accepted for now. To cover it, replace
          these files with Noto Sans CJK KR (Sans/OTF/Korean/NotoSansCJKkr-*.otf, full pan-CJK set,
          about 16 MB per weight) and change the file names in MLPDFDocument.cpp
